description: Record video screencast for compliance/audit. Compiles captured frames into video/animation (.webp, .gif, .webm, .mp4).

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

format.description: Output video format when stopping recording. Default 'webp' (pure Node native compilation).

keepFrames.description: If true, keeps raw JPEG frames after video compilation (default false).

sessionId.description: Unique recording session ID (required for start/stop).

name: browser_recording
